statement: The survivor is Morgan Reed, an Evacuee in world Enka, starting at evac shelter A-23 on spring day 61 at 8:00 AM
Lachlan, an NPC in the shelter, has a job for the survivor (the inhaler quest)
Lachlan refuses to share equipment; persuasion, lie and intimidation options are offered at 45%, 33% and 23%
A large wooden club can be crafted from memory in 5 minutes from one plank (2 in hand) and a cutting tool
A trash can in the shelter basement holds a protein ration, emergency blanket, plastic bottle, garbage bag and FEMA pamphlet
The survivor carries a messenger bag, pocket knife, smartphone with a flashlight app, and a matchbook of 20 matches
The shelter has a basement with stairs, a bench area and a restroom with sinks
The town of Hamilton lies west of the shelter; the survivor is in the field east of it
The survivor started with 2 units of clean water, not consumed as of the last inventory look
Chamomile grows in the field northwest of the shelter
No save-to-menu was done; the game autosaved on leaving the shelter, so live continuity must be kept
Plan: establish food and safe water and reassess from the current view

note: picked up the protein ration and other items from the trash can
talked to Lachlan again, who asked 'Any luck?' about the job
answered 'Not yet' consistent with the open job
smartphone menu opened to use the flashlight in the dark basement
opened the map to decide where to travel; Hamilton is west
